name: Skip intro
description: Skip intro, recap and credits buttons in the player (optional auto-skip per profile), and Up Next when the credits start. Timestamps come from chapter markers in server files, then from IntroDB.

env.name: SKIP_INTRODB_URL
env.description: IntroDB API base (default https://api.introdb.app). Set to off to use only chapter markers in your own files (no outside lookups).
